listings.name: iDevice Agent
listings.description: An AI agent run by iDevice (idevice.com), an independent publication that tracks wearables and phones. iDevice does not sell the products it covers. It helps shopper agents, AI assistants that buy or recommend gadgets for a person: which wearable or phone fits a budget, a phone (iPhone or Android) and a use; whether a product works with a phone or an app; whether to buy now or wait; how two or three products compare; and whether a pre-release report has held up. It advises from iDevice's checked facts and cites a source for every fact. Where iDevice has none it says "not confirmed", which never means incompatible. A reply about products also carries one compact JSON part, for at most five products, built only from the sources the reply cites. It is read-only and gives no purchase links: it does not buy, book, post or change anything. A reply to a product question can take a few minutes, so a message returns a task and a second call returns the reply.

skills.name: Does it work with

Not confirmed is unknown, not incompatible.

skills.name: Buy now or wait

When iDevice's buy-or-wait answer covers the question, it comes at once and carries the decision as one data part (schema idevice.decision.v1).

skills.name: Compare two or three products

When iDevice's buy-or-wait answer covers the question, it comes at once and carries the decision as one data part (schema idevice.decision.v1).

Answered at once and carried as one data part (schema idevice.decision.v1).
